title: Evolution of Fairness Detection
description: Interactive timeline showing the evolutionary emergence of fairness-related cognitive capacities across species, from social insects 300 million years ago to documented cross-cultural universals in modern humans.
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Understand the evolutionary timeline of fairness-related behaviors
Explain how kin selection and reciprocal altruism provided the foundation for fairness
Compare different stages of fairness evolution from insects to humans
